product_metadata.title: Popcorn Maker Machine by Paramount - New 8oz Capacity Hot-Oil Popper [Color: Black]

Flexible Use & Capacity: Up to 8oz [Can use 2.5oz, 4oz, 6oz, or 8oz Popcorn Packets Per Batch]
Recommended for use with Paramount Popcorn Packets
Physical Dimensions: 19.5"H x 10.5"W x 9.5"D, Operates on 110v (Standard Outlet)

description: Product Features & Specifications:  Brand New Paramount Popcorn Machine  Eight (8) Ounce Maximum Capacity  Can Use 2.5oz, 4oz, 6oz, or 8oz Popcorn Packets Per Batch  Recommended For Use With Paramount Popcorn Packets - Available Separately  Rotational & Detachable Non-Stick Ceramic Coated Hot-Oil Kettle  Built-In Electric Stirring System With Low-Noise Motor  Convenient On/Off Control Switch  Popcorn Scoop (Included)  Detachable Clear Acrylic Door  Clear Acrylic Walls  Full Instruction Manual  Easy To Use & Clean  Warranty: Limited Lifetime  Operates On 110v (Standard Outlet)  480 Watts  ETL Approved  Physical Dimensions: 19.5" Height x 10.5" Width x 9.5" Depth  Weight: ~11lbs  Notice: This product is not a "commercial" machine and is not designed for "high volume" applications. The machine body and clear walls are primarily made of plastic. Popping unlimited back-to-back batches is possible, however a single 8oz batch will fill the capacity of the machine. As with all hot-oil kettle popcorn machines, there will always be a percentage of unpopped kernels with every batch. The percentage of unpopped kernels will range from approximately 2% to 8%, depending on the type and quantity of ingredients used. Any unpopped kernels need not be discarded as most unpopped kernels can still be used as desired.
